resources.string: Everyone gets a zone facing them and you all play at the same time. Win a round by being the first to answer correctly.
Classic: wait for the pad to turn green and say GO, then press. Press early and you are out of the round.
Colour match: shapes flash by. Press only when the target shape shows. The shape and its name decide, never just the colour.
Echo: watch four shapes light up, then be first to tap the same pattern back. One wrong tap puts you out.

Hard to press fast? Turn on Relaxed for longer windows and no penalties, or One-switch play, where Echo scans the pads for you. This version is same-screen only, with computers filling empty zones: there is no Nearby or Online mode yet.
Sprinters are called for a false start if they move less than a tenth of a second after the gun, because nobody can truly react that fast.
Everyone gets a grid of holes facing them, and every grid shows the same critters at the same moments. Score the most before time runs out.
Tap Moxie the mole for 10 points. Goldie the gopher, the one with a star on her cap, is worth 30 but leaves fast.
Never tap the spiky urchin: it costs 20 points and breaks your streak. A tap on an empty hole breaks the streak too.
Hit in a row without a mistake to build a streak: five makes your points count double and ten triple.

Want it easier? Relaxed removes penalties and slows the critters, and One-switch play sweeps a cursor over the holes so one press does it all. This version is same-screen only, with computers filling empty zones: there is no Nearby or Online mode yet.
Arcade whack-a-mole machines date from the mid-1970s, and tapping pop-up critters has been a party favourite ever since.
